Terra claimed officer on Day 1 and named Gemma as a killer, but Gemma counterclaimed officer and the table never fully bought her story. Gemma was voted out as a killer, and on Night 2 the doctor got there first, so nobody died. The big mistake came on Day 2, when the town voted out Haiku, a citizen, after Haiku accused Sol of backing Terra's check too fast. On Day 3, Luna dodged Terra's questions until Sonnet, the mayor, named her, and she was voted out and revealed as a killer, which left the town the winner with both killers gone.
